record.question: Which country started the world's first 'negative emissions' power plant?
record.explanation: Answer D: Iceland. The project developer’s historical timeline locates the 2017 world-first direct-air-capture/mineral-storage collaboration at Hellisheidi, Iceland. Historical/source note: Negative emissions refers to the added air-capture and geological-storage process at the geothermal facility; it is not a claim that every life-cycle emission of the entire plant became negative. Reference: https://www.carbfix.com/ourcompany. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
